page.notes: The Greek word after "ne" is uncertain (γῷ marked [?]). "ijs" was read as the vowel form and given as "iis". "nones" in the line after "Ca-" is printed as shown, with a doubtful final letter. The italic spans were judged from the scan and may need checking. Long s is set as plain s throughout.
